notes.title: RELEASED
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31141931/0380093f917c1de111b68fcf786867e587a0f3ce.png[/img]
Hi, fellow Steam gamers!
We're delighted to announce that we have successfully entered Steam with our second title - VR Roller Coaster - Cave Depths!!!

More than 250000 players worldwide (Oculus, Google Play) have already played VR Roller Coaster, so it's the best time to grab yours as it arrives in Steam on HTC Vive!!!

Because Steam is a platform for Gamers by Gamers, we are very open to any critique, ideas and thoughts about the game. We value your opinion and work hard to make your experience as good as it can be. Because of giving an option of choosing a path during the ride, we are lucky to have such an awesome fan base.

ARLOOPA GameDev team wishes you a good gaming experience, and thrilling ride!
So, without any further ado, let's roll!

Kindest Regards,
ARLOOPA Game Development Team
